The drive showed something that predates this change. `GET /invoices` with no `page` returns `"items":[]` even though `total` is 6. The handler defaults `page` to `"1"` but slices from zero (`src/http/handlers.ts:19`), so the default request skips the first page. I left it alone because it is outside this request.

`percentOf` now rounds half up, so 7% tax on 1999 cents comes out as 140 cents, not 139.

Decisions: I changed the shared helper itself, as you asked, so the volume discount now also rounds half up instead of truncating.
